name.ja: ＨＧ 1/144 MS-06RD-4 高機動試作型ザク
name.en: HG 1/144 MS-06RD-4 High Mobility Prototype Zaku

description.ja: ジ・オリジンＭＳＤで考察されるＭＳの系譜をＨＧキットで再現！
description.en: The genealogy of MS considered in The Origin MSD is reproduced with HGKit!

description.ja: ザク系ＭＳの進化系統から誕生した “ＭＳ－０６ＲＤ－４ 高機動試作型ザク”が登場！！
description.en: “MS-06RD-4 High Mobility Prototype Zaku”, born from the evolutionary lineage of Zaku-based MS, is now available! !

description.ja: 『機動戦士ガンダム ＴＨＥ ＯＲＩＧＩＮ』ＭＳＤ（Ｍｏｂｉｌｅ Ｓｕｉｔｓ Ｄｉｓｃｏｖｅｒｙ）より、
description.en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam THE ORIGIN" MSD (Mobile Suits Discovery),

description.ja: ＯＶＡ『機動戦士ガンダム 第０８ＭＳ小隊』での登場シーンが記憶に残る、高機動試作型ザクをＨＧシリーズキットで商品化。
description.en: The high-mobility prototype Zaku, whose appearance in the OVA "Mobile Suit Gundam 08th MS Platoon" is memorable, has been commercialized as an HG series kit.

description.ja: 印象深いカラーリングを成形色で再現し、特徴的な部位や武装を新規造形で徹底再現！！
description.en: The impressive coloring is reproduced with molded colors, and the characteristic parts and weapons are thoroughly reproduced with new molding! !

description.ja: ●　紫、青、黒の組み合わせが印象的なカラーリングを成形色で再現！
description.en: ● The impressive combination of purple, blue, and black is reproduced in molded color!

description.ja: ●　特徴的なＭＳ各部位を再現！
description.en: ● Reproduce each characteristic MS part!

description.ja: 頭部、胸部、ショルダーアーマー、腰部、バックパック、脚部などの特徴的な部位の形状を、
description.en: The shape of the characteristic parts such as the head, chest, shoulder armor, waist, backpack, legs, etc.

description.ja: 新規造形を加えながら再現。
description.en: Reproduced with new modeling added.

description.ja: ジ・オリジンキットならではの巧妙なディテールを追求し、表情豊かに再現。
description.en: Pursuing the ingenious details unique to The Origin Kit, it is reproduced with rich expression.

description.ja: ●　ＭＳ用マシンガン再現！
description.en: ● Reproduction of MS machine gun!

description.ja: ザクＩＩがもつマシンガンとは形状、ディテールが異なるマシンガンを新規造形で付属。
description.en: A new machine gun with a different shape and details from the Zaku II's machine gun is included.

description.ja: ●　腰部ジョイントパーツが新規に付属し、ヒート・ホークを腰部に携行装備可能。
description.en: ● New waist joint parts are included, allowing Heat Hawk to be carried and equipped on the waist.

description.ja: ●　オリジナルマーキングが付属！
description.en: ● Original marking included!

description.ja: 付属武装 ： ＭＳ用マシンガン　／ ヒート・ホーク
description.en: Attached weapons: MS machine gun / Heat Hawk
